content.title: Disney wins big with Zootopia 2, Coupang reveals major hack
content.description:
Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Disney's (DIS) reported box office success on animated film Zootopia 2, Barrick Mining (B) weighs spinning off its North American gold assets (GC=F) via an IPO, and Coupang (CPNG) announced that a hack had exposed personal data of 33.7 million accounts.

content.title: Did the Massive Data Breach Just Shift Coupang's (CPNG) Investment Narrative?
content.summary: Earlier this year, Coupang disclosed a significant data breach that exposed personal information of approximately 33.7 million users in South Korea, attributed to unauthorized access by a former contractor using an expired authentication key. This incident has triggered the largest privacy investigation in South Korea in over ten years and could result in substantial legal and regulatory repercussions for the company.
